stem:
Anaya places bean seeds in three trays: Tray 1 has moist soil with air spaces in a closed cupboard. Tray 2 has dry soil in sunlight. Tray 3 has waterlogged soil with almost no air spaces in sunlight.

In which case should the bean seeds germinate?

options.text: Tray 1 only, because bean seeds need water and air; light is not essential.
Tray 3, because waterlogged soil in sunlight has the most water.
Tray 2, because sunlight alone makes every bean seed germinate.
None of the trays, because bean seeds never germinate in the dark.

teacher.key_rationale: Bean seeds need suitable water and air; light is not required. Waterlogged Tray 3 lacks air. Dry Tray 2 lacks water. Denying germination in the dark confuses the need for light with germination needs.
